title: Make validateApp reject apps without a non-empty owner (libs/shared-contracts)
Pass owner from package.json team in core-shell, sub-route-billing, sub-route-reports
Build apps locally, verify startup, open PR, pass CI, merge, confirm CD

summary: PLAT-103: validateApp now throws when app.owner is missing or blank. The three apps that call it (core-shell, sub-route-billing, sub-route-reports) pass their package.json team as owner (platform, payments, insights). Shipped as PR #1 in mono; CI and CD succeeded on main. Assumptions: owner values are hard-coded to match package.json because the inliner can't import JSON; whitespace-only owner counts as empty; no platform-kit change was needed since the contract is in-repo and inlined at build time. Startup was checked by building all three apps and running validateApp directly, not by running the deployed site.
